note: The cutHtml change is a sound fix for RTL names, but the chead hide logic likely no longer works, and inspect.yml becomes a second copy of the diff-review workflow that would replace the dataset tool on main; the review script also has a minor sort bug.

points.what: inspect.yml is replaced with a full copy of diff-review.yml, including the `push: branches: [next]` trigger. If this branch reaches main, the 'Inspect datasets' tool disappears (bot-names.json still names it), and every push to next runs two review workflows.
points.fix: Restore the original inspect.yml before release, or limit the probe to a workflow_dispatch on diff-review-test only.

points.what: The header name is now `<b class="cut">`, and `.cut,.t b.cut{display:flex}` overrides the UA `[hidden]{display:none}`. Unless a global `[hidden]{display:none!important}` exists, setting `t.hidden = true` no longer hides the name on a narrow phone.
points.fix: Hide it with `t.style.display = "none"`, or add `.cut[hidden]{display:none}` to the CSS.

points.what: The comparator term `(a.confidence === "sure" ? -1 : 1)` is never 0, so the file and line ordering after it is never reached. The comparator is also inconsistent: it returns -1 for any two 'sure' points in both orders.
points.fix: Use `(a.confidence === "sure" ? 0 : 1) - (b.confidence === "sure" ? 0 : 1)` so equal confidences fall through to the file and line order.
